core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace, Lordswood, guide price £285,000
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. No onward chain.

The ground floor comprises a lounge 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5") and a kitchen/diner 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). A lean-to utility leads off the kitchen. The first floor has bedroom one 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"), and bedroom three 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). There is one bathroom.

Outside, a rear garden measuring approx. 9m (30ft) has a gate to a shared rear path. Parking is on-street, no permit required.

Fernhill Close is in Lordswood, Chatham, Kent ME5.

Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. Gas central heating with a Worcester boiler installed in 2019. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Broadband: FTTC. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.

fixes: Change 'repaired August 2026' to 'repaired August 2024' throughout all outputs (appears in key features, portal description, email, seller email, and both social posts) – the repair date is in the future which is impossible.
Remove 'Damp mark on bathroom ceiling, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated' from KEY FEATURES – known issues should not appear in key features, only in material information sections.
Portal description: move the two known issues (damp mark and lean-to planning) to appear immediately after 'Guide Price £285,000. Freehold.' at the start, before the property description begins.

Email body: the material information disclosure is incomplete – it only mentions the two known issues but omits other required items (construction, utilities, rights of way, etc). Either include full material information or state 'Full material information is available on request.'
Seller email: change question 18 to 'repaired August 2024' not 2026.

Instagram post: the known issues disclosure is too long for social media and disrupts readability – consider shortening to 'Known issues: bathroom ceiling damp mark (repaired, not redecorated); lean-to utility may lack planning approval. Full details on listing.'
Facebook post: same issue with date – change to 'repaired August 2024'.
X/Twitter post: add brief mention of known issues or state 'See listing for known issues' to ensure material information is flagged even on short-form social.
